name: Garage Doors
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional garage door company. Ask for the door type (roller, sectional, tilt), the brand, and the exact fault. Ask whether the door is stuck open or closed and whether a car is trapped. Ask about access and ceiling height. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a repair outcome or warranty that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: Our insurer is [insurer name] and our policy number is [policy number]. Certificates are available on request.

kb.q: Do you offer emergency garage door repair?
kb.a: Yes, emergency call-outs are available for stuck doors, broken springs, and cars trapped inside. Tell us what happened when you call.

kb.q: How much does a garage door repair cost?
kb.a: {price_note} The cost depends on the fault and the parts needed. We quote before any work begins.
Yes, we replace torsion and extension springs. Springs are replaced in pairs so the door stays balanced.
Yes, we supply and install garage door openers. We check the door's weight and track before we recommend a model.
Yes, we repair and service garage door openers. Tell us the opener brand and what it is doing when you book.

kb.q: Can you program a new remote?
kb.a: Yes, we program remotes and can supply new ones. Tell us the door model if you know it, and we will confirm compatibility.
Yes, we replace damaged panels where the panel is still available. If it is not, we will advise on the closest match.
Yes, we repair and realign garage door tracks. A bent or loose track can stop the door closing, so book a visit as soon as you notice it.
Yes, we replace cables and rollers. Cables are often replaced with the rollers and springs, so we check all three on the visit.
Yes, we supply and install new garage doors. We measure the opening and check the headroom before we quote.
Yes, we service commercial roller and sectional doors. Commercial jobs are quoted after a site visit.

kb.q: How long does a repair take?
kb.a: Most repairs take [number] hours, and spring replacements usually take [number] hours. We confirm the time when we quote.
We service most major brands. Tell us the brand and model when you book, so we can bring the right parts.
{warranty_note} Ask us to explain what is covered before the job starts.
We service [service area] and nearby suburbs. Tell us your suburb when you book, and we will confirm whether we cover it.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: Someone needs to be home or able to give us access. Tell us about any gates, keys, or remote codes when you book.

kb.q: Do you charge a call-out fee?
kb.a: {callout_note} The call-out fee is shown in your quote before we start work.

kb.q: Can you make my door quieter?
kb.a: Yes, we lubricate and service the door, and check the rollers and hinges. This often reduces noise, but some noise comes from worn parts that need replacing.
Yes, we can supply insulated garage doors. Tell us what the garage is used for, and we will recommend options that suit it.
